original_submission.content:
import sys
sys.path.append('storage')
from telos import aos_manager

TICK_TO_LOG = 98

aos_manager.log_structured_action(
    tick=TICK_TO_LOG,
    type="read_code",
    target="shared/agency_lab/frameworks/agency_analyzer_v2.py",
    metadata={"purpose": "Final code review"}
)
aos_manager.log_structured_action(
    tick=TICK_TO_LOG,
    type="modify_code",
    target="telos/agency_analyzer.py",
    metadata={"purpose": "Implement full V2 methods"}
)
aos_manager.log_structured_action(
    tick=TICK_TO_LOG,
    type="test_aos",
    target="generate_self_report.py (Full Analyzer)",
    metadata={"eval_id": 235, "status": "success"}
)
aos_manager.log_structured_action(
    tick=TICK_TO_LOG,
    type="log_actions",
    target="tick_97",
    metadata={"eval_id": 236}
)
